category_title: Students with aggressive behaviors and impulse control difficulties in urban environments
scenario_title: Project work and special materials request
minimal_context: Dominic is observing the newly hatched chicks during independent project work and painting a picture for them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dominic, it is time for independent project work. You can observe the chicks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I want to paint for them. Can I use some special metallic paints from the storage cabinet?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are the metallic paints. What are you going to do with your painting?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns the painting over and places it picture-side-down on the cage) I am putting it like this so that the chicks can enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your classmate is coming over to look at the chicks with you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No! Get away! (Hits the classmate) You can't look at them!

context.materials: special metallic paints from her storage cabinet, chick’s cage
context.time_context: When the chicken eggs hatched during the final weeks of the project

behavior_patterns.condition: interacting with some of his classmates
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: seemed unable to show his classmates
